caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, cylindrical stove with decorative detailing. The stove stands on four short, curved legs and has a broad, circular base adorned with an intricate pattern along the edge. The main body of the stove is smooth, with a large, vertically-oriented oval ornamentation in the center featuring geometric and floral designs. On the right side, there is a rectangular, decorated door with a handle, attached to the main body, possibly for adding fuel. Atop the stove, there is a sculpted urn-like finial with two side handles and decorative elements. Behind the finial, a vertical pipe extends upward, likely representing a flue or chimney. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black on a light beige background, giving the image a monochromatic appearance with careful shading to indicate the texture and contours of the metallic surfaces. The composition is centered, with the stove being the only object in the image.
title: Amana Stove
